newsitem.title: USA: Triangle to buy Robbins flooring unit.
newsitem.headline: Triangle to buy Robbins flooring unit.

text.p: Triangle Pacific Corp said Thursday it has entered into a letter of intent, subject to due diligence and the completion of a definitive agreement, to acquire the assets and to assume certain liabilities of the residential flooring division of Robbins Inc and its affiliate Searcy Flooring Inc.

Last year, Robbins' residential division and Searcy Flooring had sales of approximately $65 million. The assets to be acquired include manufacturing plants in Warren and Searcy, Arkansas, as well as the sales and marketing operations and personnel in Cincinnati.

Robbins said Triangle Pacific's financial resources would enable it to expand output and sales of the residential products more efficiently and rapidly, and that Robbins would now concentrate its efforts on sales of flooring for recreational sports.
The terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed.
